files.description: FHIR extension fields documentation — 45-sheet Excel workbook documenting 743 custom extension fields across 28 FHIR resource types. Includes field names, types, max lengths, descriptions, and internal database table/column mappings for Enterprise, EDIS, and YourCare systems. This is the primary technical artifact for understanding the EHI export format.

Full HTML of the MEDHOST interoperability page containing the EHI Export section near the bottom. Describes two export types (single patient and system), FHIR R4 NDJSON format, and links to the extension fields XLSX.
Screenshot of the top of the MEDHOST interoperability page showing the page header and initial content.
Screenshot of the EHI Export section on the interoperability page, showing the two export types and the link to extension field documentation.

Bun TypeScript script that parses the MEDHOST FHIR Extension Fields XLSX into queryable JSON. Extracts all 43 data sheets, maps sheet names to FHIR resource types, and produces structured JSON output.
Parsed JSON output from the XLSX: array of objects, each containing sheet name, FHIR resource type, headers, and all data rows (743 total extension fields across 43 sheets).
Accounting and summary output: total sheets, parsed sheets, parse errors, field counts per resource type, unique FHIR resource types, and per-sheet header listings.
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
